digest.component_or_area: reconcile coordinator outcome versioning and manifest rendering
propositions: Versioned lifecycle/retry/fuse outcome fields must be additive and ignorable by older manifest readers while preserving existing mutation fields and canonical hash.
Cursor, baseline, and binding state advance only when postconditions are proven; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit_unknown work remains eligible for re-observation and is not counted as applied.
Mixed-pass tallies must report disjoint counts (applied, recovered, failed, skipped, deferred) that sum exactly to total mutations, with recovered un-folded from the legacy applied field.

The binding_store.repair_at_write_boundary() call must remain positioned after under-lock staleness validation and before first remote issue fetch, preserving the pre-observation repair boundary invariant.
All manifest and log content must be redacted of secrets and bounded in diagnostic fields and collections.
reconcile.py must remain under 800-line limit without raising the cap threshold.
